تتياسرون (form VI)
# تَتَيَاسَرُونَ (tatayāsarūna) /ta.ta.jaː.sa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُتَيَاسَرُونَ (tutayāsarūna) /tu.ta.jaː.sa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
